sentences: Augmentin and Amoxicillin are related but not exactly the same thing
Augmentin is a brand name for a combination antibiotic medication that contains amoxicillin and clavulanate
Amoxicillin, on the other hand, is a generic name for a type of penicillin antibiotic
The addition of clavulanate in Augmentin is intended to inhibit beta-lactamase enzymes produced by certain bacteria, making the antibiotic more effective against a broader range of bacteria

Amoxicillin, by itself, is a more general term for a type of antibiotic that may not contain clavulanate
